description.value: Pür & Simple is a Canadian breakfast and brunch franchise with over 65 locations nationwide, with this Burnaby outpost anchored inside Station Square Metro Town. The restaurant specialises in creative comfort-food twists on classics — think Eggs Benedict, French toast, pancakes, and crepes — served in an upscale indoor setting with dedicated vegan and vegetarian menu sections. Cyclists coming off the Burnaby routes can order online for takeout or join a same-day waitlist on weekends.

bike_parking_detail: 4 racks within 100m: stands (6 spaces) at 38m; stands at 71m; stands at 71m; stands (4 spaces, paid) at 96m. Total: 10 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at pursimple.com/burnaby confirms the OSM address (6096 McKay Avenue, Burnaby, BC) and phone number ((604) 428-2875) exactly. The website explicitly offers takeout and delivery ('order online for delivery or takeout'), and both OSM tags (diet:vegan=yes, diet:vegetarian=yes) and the menu pages (items labeled 'V' vegetarian and 'Vg' vegan, plus a 'gluten sentitive' filter) confirm dietary accommodations. No evidence for bike parking, water refill, Wi-Fi, or other cyclist-specific amenities appears anywhere in the website content.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, actively operating restaurant with a confirmed address, live website, and online ordering — a useful refuelling stop for touring cyclists regardless of franchise status.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu pages label items 'V' (vegetarian) and 'Vg' (vegan) and include a 'gluten sentitive' filter category
